hero.eyebrow: OSS WORKBENCH · CLOUD NATIVE · AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT
hero.description: I build Cloud Native platforms and OSS in public. I document failures and experiments, then share how the work changed my mind.

sections.now_desc: The homepage starts with active problems and experiments, not a finished portfolio.
sections.notes_desc: I start with a claim, investigate it, test it against code and real systems, and keep the result here.
sections.philosophy: I write to understand, not after I already understand.
sections.philosophy_desc: In OSS work, problem definition and verification often outlive the code itself. AI makes exploration and implementation faster, but deciding what to build and proving that it works are still my responsibility.
sections.question: Is Kubernetes-ready still enough in the age of AI agents?
